entry_points.text: Ascend moves write cursors up recomputing counts; test entry validates parameters, runs basic, search, range and span checks and releases storage; preparation sizes reservations and issues nonblocking requests with sheaf support.

PCI unmapping releases only memory-mapped regions; allocating pinning creates page storage and fails cleanly when nothing maps; user import validates buffers and vectors, handles compat layout and compacts single-segment cases.

exports.text: Tree teardown releases reservations, clears root under lock, frees owned nodes and keeps only attribute flags; recovery reports out-of-memory state, retries reservations and resets cursor on progress.

Portable I/O moves narrow and wide values with exchanged and ordered 64-bit forms via port or memory-mapped primitives, repeats element-counted transfers, copies arrays, fills and copies mappings, and allocates aligned bitmap runs honoring segment limits.

Cursor initializers establish kernel-vector, block-vector, tree-backed and discard-sink cursors with direction and budget, while advance consumes bytes across segments clamping to remainder and revert restores earlier position.

Directional engines copy between memory and cursors, move page ranges with validation, pre-fault readable user ranges, pin pages for current position consuming the span, and validate and import user vectors with fast-path reuse.

hazards.text: Staged nodes and slots stay invisible until ordered publication; lightweight staging may reorder, so early publish exposes torn state; missing siblings, short streaming progress and copy-mode narrow expansion trap.

Allocation failure enters error state requiring retry helper; range writes crossing bounds including edge null extension require spanning path; wide port stores are two observable bus operations; folio-queue rewind walks chained queues backward.

Negative lengths, inaccessible addresses and queue offset mismatch report invalid, fault or I/O error; gap query on non-vectors warns with saturated result; block segments carry page, offset and length; writeable pre-fault covers linear and vector ranges only.

Outside-dossier helpers provide RCU publication, raw and port access, reclaim-mode checks, test allocation and logging, sanitizer checks, segment iteration, temporary mapping, fault annotation, alignment tests and user-copy instrumentation.

invariants.text: Leaf staging emits side splits only when retained data extends beyond request bounds; destinations use one node when total fits else balanced parts; sources order around central buffer and stream with ceiling propagation and trailing cleanup.

Walk locates covering position for sought index; classification prefers root and spanning handling then split for growth with reservation sizing from height and path; narrow store overwrites adjacent positions while node store rebuilds around replacement.

High addresses use memory-mapped access, intermediate use masked port access and low are invalid with bounded warning; repeated memory operations loop at fixed device address; mapping copies isolate unaligned head and tail from aligned middle.

Single-segment query returns lesser of remainder and segment rest; user totals beyond global maximum truncate; alignment and page-count queries handle vector-like, block, queue and tree kinds with neutral zero-length results; page transfers validate offset plus length before touching data.

locks.text: Replacement requires write lock held with height from dedicated query; publication uses ordered stores with gap refresh; recovery runs under lock, dropping it across blocking reclaim when no external lock is used.
Tree-backed page materialization holds read-side protection across lookup until references are taken, retrying when entries change under the reader.

state_machines.text: Sibling search ascends both cursors then descends extreme edges to leaves, faulting if none; ascent folds sibling into extended side, converts destinations to staged slots with ceilings, and ascends for another round with fresh source views.

Write walk descends sampling prior content until leaf; node store rebuilds around replacement; preparation normalizes cursor and classifies store kind; allocation satisfies singletons from staged storage or fresh nodes and larger asks from sheaf-backed reserves.

Block and folio-queue iterators slide within then across segments resetting offset at boundaries and wrapping queues on exhaustion; page extraction consumes mapped span and allocation-backed pinning reports first-page offset.

structs.text: Spanning tally adds retained prefix plus staged plus suffix with sibling pull on thin sides; source views hold node address, type tag, span and ceiling; setup caches node views and position transfer copies reference, offset, end, interval and depth.

Header separates height bits from persistent attributes; write state links cursor, slot and pivot views, bounds, current and replacement content and end positions; fresh typeless allocations convert via dedicated cast helper.

Cursor holds kind tag, direction, remaining count, intra-segment offset, segment count and kind-specific base, queue slot or tree start; saved position keeps remainder, offset and segment count; vector segments carry base plus length.

Port threshold is 0x10000, mask 0x0ffff, memory-mapped boundary 0x40000; invalid reads yield all-ones per width; full key universe spans zero to maximum unsigned long; distinct kind tags and global transfer and page-granularity bounds govern iterator paths.
